description: pdf.js 6.2.108 getTextContent() item streams (str, dir, width, height, transform, hasEOL) of twenty small synthetic PDFs (pdf-lib, standard Helvetica, invented text): what the frozen Rule B3 does at table cell and row boundaries (T1-T15) and on ordinary text that carries gaps (C1-C5). `outcome` says how a fixture counts: T13 is an ACCEPTED RESIDUAL (a wrong join Rule B3 still makes), not a protection.
